name: marimba_ostinato
description: Wooden-bar rolling pattern of chord tones in three-three-two.
character: A wooden-bar marimba playing a rolling three-three-two pattern of chord tones: the interlocking engine of the arrangement, soft and round so it supports the tune.
sources: KB african (interlocking patterns across a cycle; wooden-bar instruments)
KB indian-film-fusion (the three-three-two Tisra pulse over an eight-beat cycle)
ESTIMATE: level and placement are starting values
STARTING VALUE: onset_fade_ms 8: several strokes land together on every strong beat and their sharp starts add into one impulse the click row flags; a soft attack is also what "smooth" asks for

STARTING VALUE: low-pass at 4.5 kHz: a phone speaker returns little above about 5 kHz (KB short-form-functional-music), and the sharp edges of plucked and struck onsets above it are what the click row reacts to
MEASURED: short_form_report found 10.5% of the master below 200 Hz and 13.9% from 200 to 300 Hz, where a phone speaker returns little; STARTING VALUE: high-pass at 250 Hz

CARRIED OVER from the ringtone project 'Confluence', where each filter, fade and level in this preset was set by a measurement (click count, stem.dropout, equal_loudness); not re-measured for the alarm until the gate runs
